abstract_evidence_excerpt: Iron (Fe) phases are tightly linked to the preservation rather than the loss of organic carbon (OC) in soil; however, during redox fluctuations, OC may be lost due to Fe phase-mediated abiotic processes. Collectively, our findings might unveil the under-appreciated role of active Fe phases in driving more loss than conservation of OC in soil redox
